stem: Chromium, $\text{Cr}$, and its compounds are widely used in many chemical reactions.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
The most common isotope of $\text{Cr}$ is chromium-52.

Determine the number of protons, neutrons and electrons in an atom of chromium-52.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Describe how an atom of chromium-54 differs from an atom of chromium-52. Refer to numbers of particles in your answer.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
The relative isotopic masses of the isotopes of $\text{Cr}$ can be determined using mass spectrometry.

State what other information is needed to calculate the relative atomic mass, $A_{\text{r}}$, of $\text{Cr}$.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text:
Atoms of $^{52}\text{Cr}$, $^{53}\text{Cr}$ and $^{54}\text{Cr}$ make up more than 95% of naturally occurring chromium atoms. The $A_{\text{r}}$ of naturally occurring $\text{Cr}$ is 51.996.

Suggest what these statements imply about the relative isotopic mass of the fourth stable isotope of chromium.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: The shorthand electronic configuration of chromium is $[\text{Ar}] 3\text{d}^5 4\text{s}^1$.
parts.text: Complete the full electronic configuration of chromium.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Deduce the total number of unpaired electrons in an atom of chromium.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Acidified dichromate(VI) ions will convert methanal, $\text{CH}_2\text{O}$, to carbon dioxide. The movement of electrons to or from relevant species is shown in the following half-equations.

half-equation 1 $\text{CH}_2\text{O} + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{CO}_2 + 4\text{H}^+ + 4\text{e}^-$

half-equation 2 $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-} + 14\text{H}^+ + 6\text{e}^- \rightarrow 2\text{Cr}^{3+} + 7\text{H}_2\text{O}$
parts.text: Identify the species that is reduced in half-equation 2. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
The oxidation state of the carbon atom in methanal is 0.

Calculate the oxidation state of carbon in carbon dioxide.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Construct the ionic equation for the reaction of dichromate(VI) ions with methanal in acidic conditions.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Methanal is a liquid at $-30^{\circ}\text{C}$ but carbon dioxide is a gas at this temperature. Explain why.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
In acidic conditions, a dynamic equilibrium is established between $\text{CrO}_4^{2-}\text{(aq)}$ and $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}\text{(aq)}$.

$$2\text{CrO}_4^{2-}\text{(aq)} + 2\text{H}^+\text{(aq)} \rightleftharpoons \text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}\text{(aq)} + \text{H}_2\text{O(l)} \quad \Delta H > 0$$
parts.text: State what is meant by dynamic equilibrium.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the condition necessary to establish dynamic equilibrium.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text:
$\text{CrO}_4^{2-}\text{(aq)}$ ions are yellow and $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}\text{(aq)}$ ions are orange.

State what is observed when the following changes are made to an equilibrium mixture of acidified $\text{CrO}_4^{2-}\text{(aq)}$ and $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}\text{(aq)}$ ions.

Explain your answers.

- The equilibrium mixture is warmed gently.

- Dilute $\text{HCl}\text{(aq)}$ is added to the equilibrium mixture.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Chromium(IV) fluoride, $\text{CrF}_4$, is a covalent molecule that shows similar chemical properties to $\text{SiCl}_4$.

Suggest the type of reaction that occurs when $\text{CrF}_4$ is placed in water.

Construct a relevant equation for this reaction.
